concept.title: Typography, lists, and links
concept.shortdesc: This short description renders as the page's lead paragraph; ordinary paragraphs like the ones below take the GOV.UK body style.

conbody.p: Body text uses the Design System's type scale and spacing. Inline semantics carry through: bold text for strong emphasis, italics where DITA authors use them, inline code such as --format=govuk, and user-interface labels like Save or the cascade FileExport.
Cross-references pick up the link style, including focus and hover states. This one resolves through a key: . This one goes outside the site: .
